setup.text: A village debates whether fruit that falls on its own belongs to people, birds, or the forest.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The stores fill, but fewer animals visit the grove.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: The harvest spoils faster than the villagers can preserve it.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: Birds and insects feast, while the village keeps a smaller share.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: A hungry family questions whether the division is fair.

c1.text: The village adapts its harvest to the year's abundance.

c2.text: A drought forces the council to reconsider the rule.
